user.title: Lichtschnitzel
user.description: Address of the lamp, e.g. lichtschnitzel-a1b2c3.local. The password is only needed if the lamp has one for control.

confirm.description: Set up {name} at {host}? The password is only needed if the lamp has one for control.

reauth_confirm.description: The lamp refused the stored password. Enter the password for control.

error.password_needed: The lamp needs a password for control.
error.unknown: The lamp answered with an error.

abort.already_configured: This lamp is already set up.

set_parameter.name: Set effect parameter
set_parameter.description: Sets a parameter of the effect a screen shows, e.g. Speed or a colour. Values are clamped to the parameter's limits.

parameter.name: Parameter
parameter.description: Name of the parameter as in the light's "parameters" attribute, e.g. Speed or Flying Emitters/Period Length.

value.name: Value
value.description: A number, or a colour as [r, g, b] or #rrggbb.

not_a_screen.message: {entity} is not a screen of a Lichtschnitzel lamp.
